blurb: Thank you for visiting US National Taekwondo Center's Web Site. The home of the Official USA Taekwondo National Team Head Coach and the only Olympic Style Taekwondo Team Head Coach in Monmouth and Ocean county. We teach adults and children ages 3 years old and older the Korean martial arts of Taekwondo. If you would like more information about Grandmaster Kim's specialized classes, please call or e-mail us!
